tasks.final_text: The National Museum of Gaille (Galle National Museum) is one of the national museums of Sri Lanka. It is located in the oldest remaining Dutch building in the Galle fort, Galle, a single storey colonnaded Dutch building built in 1656 as the commisariat store for the Dutch garrison at the fort.

My favorite food has to be breakfast burritos. They're something that I ate growing up, and now I make them all the time. Mostly, I'm just a sucker for anything with pork sausage in it. Now that I'm an adult, I get to make them exactly how I like them, with no peppers. I've also started experimenting with adding hash browns.
